news.headline: NeurAxis Form 4 filings: CEO and CMO convert stock options into RSUs, vest RSU shares
news.summary: Insider filings show CEO Brian Carrico and CMO Adrian Miranda each converted large blocks of stock options (320,000 and 337,204 respectively) into RSUs and had RSUs vest into common shares, completing the previously announced Stock Option Exchange. This is a routine administrative/compensation filing, not a new business development.

news.headline: NeurAxis discloses Stock Option Exchange completion and new RSU grants to executives and directors
news.summary: NeurAxis reported that its option-for-RSU exchange became effective (options swapped 1-for-1 into RSUs for CEO Brian Carrico, CMO Adrian Miranda and CRO Thomas Carrico) and disclosed new three-year vesting RSU grants plus one-time equity awards totaling 127,120 shares to independent directors.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge, Gross Margin Up
news.source: Zacks / TradingView / The Globe and Mail
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 7-8% (and were down ~8.6% versus a flat S&P 500 in the days after the report) as investors focused on a wider-than-expected per-share loss ($0.19 vs. $0.16 forecast) despite record revenue and expanding gross margin.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% YoY to $1.9M with 85.9% gross margin, driven by the new Category I CPT code for PENFS effective Jan 1, 2026 and expanded payer coverage; cash on hand was $8.3M after raising $2.5M via ATM/warrant redemptions. On the earnings call management said Q3 remains 'TBD' with more sequential growth expected in Q4, and flagged progress with two large remaining payer holdouts that could push covered lives materially higher into 2027.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim representing over 500,000 newly covered lives, expanding beneficiary access in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it would report Q2 2026 financial results and host a business update conference call before market open on August 11, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report; management called Q3 revenue trajectory 'TBD' on the Q2 call and pointed to more sequential growth in Q4 2026

catalysts.label: Decisions from two large holdout commercial payers
catalysts.detail: Management is 'cautiously optimistic' that medical policy coverage from two of the largest remaining uncovered national payers lands in this window; CEO said he'd be 'highly disappointed' if covered lives were not above 200M by 2027

catalysts.label: Payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Continued rollout of new regional/state medical policies for PENFS/IB-Stim following the August 4 500,000-covered-lives update

catalysts.label: Category I CPT code reimbursement ramp
catalysts.detail: Continued revenue benefit from the CPT Category I code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026, cited as the primary growth driver in Q1 and Q2 2026

catalysts.label: Rising opex / commercial investment
catalysts.detail: Management guided to higher operating expenses in H2 2026 as it hires sales, marketing, clinical and policy staff, aiming toward eventual cash-flow breakeven (no firm timeline given)

catalysts.label: RED device and adult-indication clinical studies
catalysts.detail: R&D spend increased in Q2 2026 to fund new clinical studies supporting adult IB-Stim indications and further indication expansion; commercialization progress on the RED (rectal expulsion device) product remains unquantified

pulse: Since the last refresh (through Aug 19), the only additional item is a routine Aug 24 Form 4 filing completing the previously disclosed option-to-RSU exchange for the CEO and CMO — no new business catalysts have emerged. The core story is unchanged: record Q2 revenue (+116% YoY) on the new CPT Category I code and payer coverage expansion, but the stock sold off ~7-8% post-earnings on a wider-than-expected per-share loss as opex rises to fund commercial expansion. The key forward catalyst to watch is whether NeurAxis lands one or both of the two large remaining commercial-payer holdouts in H2 2026/early 2027, which management frames as the key lever toward its 200M+ covered-lives target.
